Vicon Creator · On-location photography

Photographer in Utrecht

A family photoshoot in Utrecht works best when the route fits the family. A couple session or personal portrait may use the same city in a very different way. Vicon Creator photographs on location across the Netherlands, including Utrecht, with the setting chosen around your story.

Canal level or street level?

Utrecht’s canals and wharves offer more than one perspective. Near the Oudegracht, decide whether a waterside setting is practical for everyone or whether staying at street level makes the session easier. A short route with time to stop can be more useful than a checklist of landmarks. Access, steps and current conditions should be checked for your chosen meeting point.

Let children set part of the pace

For a family session, share the children’s ages, how far you want to walk and whether anyone needs a break or easy access. Bring a familiar layer and a small, easy snack. A session does not have to depend on everyone looking at the camera at once: walking, closeness and individual portraits can also tell the story.

Couples, portraits and wedding plans

For couples, choose an activity or place that makes conversation easy. For portraits, share the intended use and a few examples of the mood you like. If you are planning a wedding in Utrecht, send the venue and timeline so coverage can be discussed using the Netherlands wedding collection. Travel and any venue costs are agreed before booking.

Location background: Discover Utrecht: canals and wharves. Access and any permissions are confirmed for the proposed session.

Planning your session

A little preparation.

What to wear for a couples, portrait or family photoshoot

Choose clothes you can move, sit and breathe comfortably in. The most useful outfit is one that feels like you and works with the location. A cinematic photograph does not require a special wardrobe.

Read the guide ↗︎

What if it rains on your photoshoot day?

Make a weather plan before the day arrives. Cloud, a light shower and persistent rain call for different decisions. The aim is a session you can enjoy, with the final location and any changes agreed together.

Read the guide ↗︎

A family photoshoot with children: a practical plan

A useful family session plan leaves room for children to be themselves. Start with who is joining, a manageable location and a few photographs that matter to you. The day does not have to depend on a perfect group pose.
